items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: No, I don't hear of any talk about Eddie Miller's clarinet playing... everybody worships Eddie Miller's tenor playing with the Bobcats.

ctx.x: Well, you've deviated a little. I wondered if there were other clarinets than Fozola who might have left a stamp. Was Eddie Miller playing enough clarinet with the Bobcats that anybody speaks about him today? He says, this is an Eddie Miller soul?

No, I don't hear of any talk about Eddie Miller's clarinet playing. Nor, for that matter, of Bud Freeman, who I thought was a very good clarinet player. No, everybody in the same vein, everybody worships Eddie Miller's tenor playing with the Bobcats. They think it's the ultimate of clean, accurate playing.
Who are we talking about on all the West Coast records? The clarinet player who does so much arraignment? Matlock.
